title: Layout Pdf Export End To End
description: Get the layout artifact's PDF export working fully end to end: the shell's Export Pdf action runs the resumable LayoutExportJob, the job renders every page (frames, text, images) into a valid PDF, the bytes reach the browser as a download, and the file opens with the expected page count and content.
note: Ticket bookkeeping manual on disk: repo MCP timed out (2026-09-18). Follows 26/09/16/LAYOUT-PLUGIN-END-TO-END (serve/probe scripts reused).
summary: Layout PDF export works end to end in the react playground: Export Pdf → OpBinary wire decoded (was JSON-text scan, every export faulted) → resumable job renders every page from the Preview's display list with the embedded MapLabelSans CIDFont, y-flipped rects/strokes/image placeholders, streaming objects → download built on the job's own chunk queue (the mounted operation drained the request's queue at retirement → 0-byte files) → Demo.pdf 29 KiB, PyMuPDF-verified 2 pages with ink where the document paints, live edits included. Native laws: xref/stream structure walk + host-turn drain law.
